FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Ingredients 2 chicken brst 1 tbsp olive oil 1/4 tsp baking soda 1 tsp oregano 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Juice and zest of 1 small lemon Salt & pepper to taste Optional: 2 tbsp  yogurt Here is how I made it: 1.Add 2 chicken brsts to a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp baking soda to soften up the fibers, the zest & juice of a lemon, and optional: 2 tbsp plain yogurt. Mix well, and make sure the chicken is at room temperature (not cold!) This is important!! 2.Let this marinate for 30 minutes (outside of the fridge). By not using cold chicken, it help cook the chicken evenly. 3.Bring a pan to medium heat. Once it’s hot, place the chicken in the pan. Cover with a lid and cook for 3 mins on the first side. This is going to trap the moisture. 4.After 3 mins, flip it, cover with the lid, reduce heat to MEDIUM-LOW, and let it cook for another 7-8 mins. If you used cold chicken, or if your pan wasn’t hot enough, or if your chicken was too thick, this may require more time (and not be juicy, so follow the directions! 5. After 7-8 minutes remove the chicken from the pan, place it on a cutting board or plate, and let it rest for at least 5 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute throughout the chicken, making it more tender and locking in the juices.   6.After resting, slice the chicken breasts against the grain and serve. You can serve this however way you wish – with your favorite veggies, salad, or with rice, quinoa, or if you’re looking for lowcarb/keto options, my @Kaizen Food Company lowcarb rice. Heat the frying pan over a medium heat, perform the drop test, then add 1 tbsp olive oil. Add the chicken skin-side down and cook for 6-8 minutes until deeply golden and crisp Turn the chicken, then add 30g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and 4-5 sprigs of thyme. Once foaming, baste the chicken for 102 minutes, then transfer the chicken to a roasting tray and put in a 200°C fan oven for 10-15 minutes until cooked through. Remove and rest Leave around 1 tbsp of the chicken fat and all the caramelised pan juices behind. Add 2 finely sliced shallots and 1 finely sliced leek with a pinch of salt and cook gently for 5-7 minutes until softened. Add 2 sliced garlic cloves and cook for another minute Add 2 x 400g jars of good quality butter beans, 200ml chicken stock, and 1 tbsp Dijon mustard. Bring to a gentle simmer, then crush some of the beans into the stock to thicken it Turn the heat down and stir through 75g crème fraîche and 15-20g finely grated Parmesan. Extra Crispy Chicken Strips 🍗 Chicken 1½ lb boneless, skinless chicken breast ¾ cup pickle juice 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ½ tsp black pepper Crispy Coating 1½ cups all-purpose flour ½ cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ½ tsp cayenne pepper, optional 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp baking powder 3–4 tbsp pickle juice or cold water, for making flour clumps 1 bowl very cold water Oil, for frying Cane’s-Style Sauce ½ cup mayonnaise ¼ cup ketchup 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp onion powder Pinch of salt Instructions Slice the chicken breasts horizontally into thinner pieces, then cut into small, thin strips. Add the chicken to a bowl with pickle juice, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and black pepper. Mix well and marinate in the refrigerator for 1–2 hours. For the sauce, mix mayo, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, paprika, onion powder and a pinch of salt. Refrigerate until ready to serve. In a large bowl, combine flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, salt, black pepper and baking powder. Drizzle 3–4 tablespoons of pickle juice or cold water into the flour mixture and rub it through with your fingertips until little flour clumps form. Remove the chicken from the pickle marinade and let the excess drip off. Coat each piece well in the seasoned flour. Quickly dunk the coated chicken into very cold water for about 1 second, then immediately return it to the flour mixture. Press, squeeze and scrunch the flour onto the chicken so lots of rough, craggy pieces form. Don’t shake off too much flour. Let the coated chicken rest for 3–5 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F and fry in batches for about 3–5 minutes, depending on the size of the strips, until golden, crispy and cooked through to 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack. For extra crunch, let the chicken rest for 5–10 minutes, increase the oil to 375°F and fry again for about 45–60 seconds. Serve with the Cane’s-style sauce. Tips: The secret to the crinkly coating is making little clumps in the flour and really squeezing the second flour coating onto the chicken. Keep the water dunk very quick so you don’t wash off the first layer. . #crispychicken #chickenstrips #cook #recipe #foodie
